business_summary: F8 Enterprises (Holdings) Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the sale and transportation of diesel oil and related products in Hong Kong. The company offers marine refueling services for construction vessels, lubricant oil delivery services, and tank wagon fuel delivery services. It also sells steel products. In addition, the company operates a fleet of eight diesel tank wagons, a marine oil barge, and a vessel, as well as provides industrial diesel oil for construction projects, marine diesel oil for construction vessels, and lubricant oil for construction machinery and vehicles automobiles. F8 Enterprises (Holdings) Group Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong. F8 Enterprises (Holdings) Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Grand Tycoon Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 F8 Enterprises (Holdings) Group Limited는 홍콩에서 디젤유 및 관련 제품의 판매 및 운송에 종사하고 있습니다. 건설선박용 해상급유 서비스, 윤활유 배송 서비스, 탱크 왜건 연료 배송 서비스를 제공하는 회사입니다. 철강제품도 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 디젤 탱크 왜건 8대, 해상유 바지선, 선박 1척을 운영하고 있으며, 건설 프로젝트용 산업용 디젤유, 건설 선박용 해양 디젤유, 건설 기계 및 자동차용 윤활유를 제공하고 있습니다. F8 Enterprises (Holdings) Group Limited는 2016년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 카오룽 베이에 본사를 두고 있습니다. F8 Enterprises (Holdings) Group Limited는 Grand Tycoon Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
